judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: Single pieces sound like Nox (the bats in the bellows, 'Heh, heh, heh...', the terse two-line journal), but the speech is a collage: the urgent 'no time to send for help' runs straight into a potion-seller tip and then a cynical aside about heroes, with no shift in tone between them. Westwood's quest-givers stay on one note.
